title: Note: New Best Practice using Azure OpenAI as provider in Sep. 2026

cues.en: Hi, Rasmus from the future here compared to when the rest of the videos were created.
cues.zh: 大家好，我是來自未來的 Rasmus；相較之下，其他影片是在更早之前錄製的。

cues.en: They were created back in January 2026 and as of this recording it is September 2026.
cues.zh: 那些影片錄於 2026 年 1 月，現在錄製這段更新時，已經是 2026 年 9 月。

cues.en: So when the videos were recorded we were just about to hit version 1.0.
cues.zh: 當時錄製影片時，框架即將推出 1.0 版。

cues.en: We are now at version 1.21 and this version have a kind of breaking change that I just wanted to highlight to you.
cues.zh: 現在已經來到 1.21 版，其中有一項類似不相容變更的調整，我想特別提醒大家。

cues.en: It doesn't affect anything in the course as such, but it is a new best practice in how you do connections to Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 這不會直接影響課程內容，但連接 Azure OpenAI 現在有了新的最佳做法。

cues.en: In that the packets I show in the various videos is azure.ai.openai and they have put
cues.zh: 我在各段影片示範的是 Azure.AI.OpenAI 套件，而官方現在建議，

cues.en: in that we should consider removing this package and do it in a slightly different manner.
cues.zh: 應考慮移除這個套件，改用稍微不同的方式。

cues.en: So that is the only thing that is affected and even if you don't do this you will and
cues.zh: 受影響的就只有這一點。即使你不調整，

cues.en: still follow the videos line by line it will still work, but it's more if you begin to
cues.zh: 照著影片逐行操作，仍然可以運作。不過，當你開始

cues.en: use some of the more advanced features that are in the later videos of this course that you will run into trouble.
cues.zh: 使用本課後段介紹的某些進階功能時，就可能遇到問題。

cues.en: More specifically when you use something called the responses API.
cues.zh: 更具體來說，就是使用 Responses API 的時候。

cues.en: So for that reason I wanted to highlight up front here and I've already updated the source
cues.zh: 因此我想先在前面提醒大家。我也已經更新 GitHub 配套儲存庫的原始碼，

cues.en: code in the GitHub companion repository, but of course the videos will not show this.
cues.zh: 但影片當然還是舊的畫面。

cues.en: But the main thing is that whenever we make a connection and make our agent, we used to
cues.zh: 主要差異在於：以前建立連線和代理程式時，

cues.en: use Azure OpenAI client and say new with an endpoint and an API key and we used this package here.
cues.zh: 會建立 AzureOpenAIClient，傳入端點及 API 金鑰，並使用這個套件。

cues.en: This is the package that Microsoft says to us we shouldn't use anymore.
cues.zh: 微軟現在建議不要再使用這個套件。

cues.en: So in the sample repo I have removed this package and I have replaced the code with
cues.zh: 所以我已在範例儲存庫移除它，並替換了相關程式碼。

cues.en: not with a new package because it's not needed because we have the OpenAI package here already from agent framework.
cues.zh: 沒有另外新增套件，因為 Agent Framework 已經帶入 OpenAI 套件，足夠使用。

cues.en: We can add one more package but that's only if you want to use more advanced logins using
cues.zh: 如果想使用更進階的登入方式，才需要額外新增一個套件，

cues.en: not API keys but your Azure credentials.
cues.zh: 也就是不用 API 金鑰，改用 Azure 認證。

cues.en: We don't really use that in the course but it is possible to do as well.
cues.zh: 課程中沒有太多使用這個方式，但確實也做得到。

cues.en: But the new way of doing it is that we use the OpenAI client instead of the Azure OpenAI
cues.zh: 新的做法是使用 OpenAIClient，取代 AzureOpenAIClient。

cues.en: client and when you knew this up it's slightly different format in that the key goes first
cues.zh: 建立執行個體時，參數格式稍微不同：先傳入金鑰，

cues.en: and then you give some extra OpenAI client options and the endpoint goes down here instead of directly in the constructor.
cues.zh: 再提供 OpenAIClientOptions，端點放在這裡，而不是直接傳進建構函式。

cues.en: When we do that we just give it the normal name.openai.azure.com and then we need to
cues.zh: 設定時使用一般的 name.openai.azure.com，後面還需要

cues.en: give extra slash OpenAI slash v1.
cues.zh: 加上 /openai/v1。

cues.en: This slash OpenAI slash v1 was what this package did by itself but whenever we use the OpenAI
cues.zh: 以前這個套件會自動加上 /openai/v1；但使用 OpenAIClient 時，

cues.en: client we need to tell that it's actually the OpenAI part we want to use.
cues.zh: 我們得明確指定要使用 OpenAI 這一段路徑。

cues.en: That is the only change and if you look at the video and look at the repo that would be a change you will notice.
cues.zh: 這就是唯一的變更，也是你比較影片和儲存庫時會注意到的差異。

cues.en: Here's how you do it with role-based access control Azure credentials in that you give
cues.zh: 這裡也示範了 Azure 角色型存取控制的認證方式：

cues.en: a bearer token policy in instead of your key but else you do exactly the same.
cues.zh: 用 BearerTokenPolicy 取代金鑰，其餘做法完全相同。

cues.en: Once you have this in place everything works the same way.
cues.zh: 設定完成後，所有功能都會以相同方式運作。

cues.en: Again if you don't want to you can still use this throughout the course but in real
cues.zh: 再次說明，如果你不想改，整門課仍然可以用原本的方式完成；但之後撰寫

cues.en: production code that you write after the fact I definitely recommend you begin to do this instead.
cues.zh: 正式環境的程式時，我非常建議改採這個新的方式。

cues.en: So that's everything back to the course.
cues.zh: 更新就到這裡，回到課程吧。
